title: Quasinormal-mode residues and pole coalescence in hypergeometric black-hole models
summary: We study source-normalized quasinormal-mode residues in radial boundary-value problems reducible to the Gauss hypergeometric equation. Hypergeometric connection coefficients separate the spectral condition from the normalization and spatial dependence of the frequency-domain Green function. We illustrate this construction for Dirichlet modes of the rotating Bañados--Teitelboim--Zanelli black hole and mixed boundary conditions in two-dimensional anti-de Sitter spacetime, and then apply it to the Pöschl--Teller/Nariai problem.
